# Tripomonk

> Tripomonk is an adventure and trekking company based in Uttarakhand, India. It offers guided Himalayan treks with certified trek leaders, fixed departures, rental gear and safety-first, acclimatisation-aware itineraries across Uttarakhand, Himachal, Ladakh, Kashmir, Sikkim, the Northeast and the Western Ghats. Trekkers can browse treks, check fitness readiness, rent gear, apply for permits and book online.

## About
- Founded in Uttarakhand, India; focused on the Indian Himalaya and beyond.
- Recognitions: NIDHI, Startup India, Startup UP, MSME.
- Every trek includes a certified leader, safety equipment, permits & forest fees, meals on trek and accommodation.
- Booking: 25% advance to reserve a seat, balance before the trek; free cancellation up to 15 days prior.
- Rental gear and assisted permit applications are available.

## Bookable treks (live)
- **Kedarkantha** (Uttarakhand) — 5-day easy trek, max altitude 12,500 ft, best Dec – Apr, from ₹6,499. Base: Sankri; nearest rail Dehradun (~200 km), airport Dehradun (Jolly Grant).
- **Brahmatal** (Uttarakhand) — 6-day moderate trek, max altitude 12,250 ft, best Dec – Mar, from ₹8,999. Base: Lohajung; nearest rail Kathgodam (~215 km), airport Pantnagar / Dehradun.
- **Valley of Flowers** (Uttarakhand) — 6-day moderate trek, max altitude 14,100 ft, best Jul – Sep, from ₹9,499. Base: Govindghat / Pulna; nearest rail Rishikesh (~275 km), airport Dehradun (Jolly Grant).
- **Har Ki Dun** (Uttarakhand) — 7-day moderate trek, max altitude 11,700 ft, best Apr – Jun, from ₹10,499. Base: Sankri / Taluka; nearest rail Dehradun (~210 km), airport Dehradun (Jolly Grant).
- **Nag Tibba** (Uttarakhand) — 2-day easy trek, max altitude 9,915 ft, best Oct – Mar, from ₹3,499. Base: Pantwari; nearest rail Dehradun (~90 km), airport Dehradun (Jolly Grant).
- **Roopkund** (Uttarakhand) — 8-day difficult trek, max altitude 15,750 ft, best May – Jun, from ₹13,999. Base: Lohajung; nearest rail Kathgodam (~215 km), airport Pantnagar / Dehradun.
- **Yulla Kanda** (Himachal) — 5-day moderate trek, max altitude 11,700 ft, best May – Oct, from ₹10,500. Base: Sarahan → Yulla (Kinnaur); nearest rail Shimla (~230 km), airport Shimla / Chandigarh.
